fields.name: site
fields.label: Site

options.notes: Loaded by useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:34-41) and mapped by mapLocationOptions (location-options.ts:25-36): when a row has location_type the option value is the encoded string 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]', otherwise the bare id. location_type is a repeated static query param.

fields.query_param_normalization: Resolved against loaded locations by encoded value, provider id, or display name (resolveLocationFormValue, location-options.ts:62-77); unresolvable value clears site and device (port-lldp-info-workflow-form.tsx:189-207). Ignored when remote_mac_address is in the URL: form.reset sets site to '' (:230-239).
client_only_validation: UI-only field: required when device or interface has a value (superRefine case 2, :63-86)
Disabled while remote_mac_address has a value (:310)
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted; only filters the device option query (site and site_type query params via useDevices.ts:42-51).

fields.name: device_id
fields.label: Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the network device to inspect.

options.notes: useDevices (useDevices.ts:36-64) with filterParams [site, managed_only=true] (port-lldp-info-workflow-form.tsx:180-187). No request until site is set (useDevices.ts:54). site/site_type are split from the encoded site option value (parseLocationValue, useDevices.ts:43-50); the depended-on site field is UI-only.

fields.query_param_normalization: Kept only if present in the loaded device options for the site, otherwise cleared (:209-223). Ignored when remote_mac_address is in the URL (:230-239).
client_only_validation: Required when site or interface has a value (superRefine case 2, :72-78)
Disabled while remote_mac_address has a value (:321)
fields.submit_transform: UI form field 'device' is renamed to 'device_id' (:276-279); the key is omitted entirely when remote_mac_address is set.

fields.name: interface
fields.label: Interface
fields.query_param_normalization: Raw string. Ignored when remote_mac_address is in the URL (:230-239).
client_only_validation: Required when site or device has a value (superRefine case 2, :79-85)
Disabled while remote_mac_address has a value (:330)
fields.submit_transform: Trimmed string; omitted entirely when remote_mac_address is set.

fields.name: remote_mac_address
fields.label: MAC Address
fields.schema_description: MAC address of the remote device to locate.
fields.query_param_normalization: Raw string. When present it takes precedence: form.reset clears site/device/interface even if those query params are also present (:230-239; spec portlldpinfoForm.spec.ts:341-379).
client_only_validation: Required unless site, device and interface are all set (superRefine case 1, :53-61)
Must not be combined with complete device info (superRefine case 3, :88-96)
Disabled while any device field has a value (:339)
Entering a value clears site, device and interface (setMacAddressMode, :110-123)
No MAC format validation in UI or schema
fields.submit_transform: If non-empty the whole payload is {remote_mac_address} only (:274-275).

payload_transform: onSubmit (port-lldp-info-workflow-form.tsx:271-292): if the trimmed remote_mac_address is non-empty the body is {"remote_mac_address": <mac>}; otherwise {"device_id": <device>, "interface": <interface>}. site is never sent and no null keys are sent. startWorkflow JSON.stringify()s the object and POSTs it to /v1/workflow/ngc/port_lldp_info (utils.tsx:153-183), then navigates to /workflows/<id>.
discrepancies: Schema makes device_id, interface and remote_mac_address all optional with no model validator (lldp.py:55-65); the either/or rule is enforced only by the UI superRefine (:47-97) and at workflow runtime (ApplicationError at lldp.py:138), so an API POST of {} is accepted and fails after the run starts.
The UI forbids complete device info together with a MAC address (superRefine case 3); the schema accepts both and the workflow silently prefers device_id+interface (lldp.py:110-124).
The UI requires interface whenever device is set; the schema allows device_id without interface, which falls through to the MAC branch or the runtime error (lldp.py:110-138).
site is a UI-only cascade filter with no schema property.
Labels differ from schema titles: 'Device' vs 'Device Id', 'MAC Address' vs 'Remote Mac Address'.
interface is free text even though /v1/parameter/device/{device_id}/interfaces exists (used by the SpX tenant change form).
The site-change effect (:225-228) contains a stray console.log('changing') and also clears device on mount; the query device is restored by the validation effect once options load.
contract_gaps: Mutual exclusion between the device group {site, device_id, interface} and remote_mac_address, where each group disables the other and clears its values: VisibleIf can only hide, and expressing this needs circular rules (device fields visible_if remote_mac_address equals ''/null and remote_mac_address visible_if device_id equals ''/null). There are no clearing semantics.
The at-least-one-group rule (complete device info OR MAC address) has no hint; requires_together only covers the device group.
The payload must omit the inactive group's keys (not send null or ''); the contract does not define an omit-hidden or omit-empty submit rule.
The UI-only 'site' filter has no schema property, and ui_schema.fields can only key model fields, so the site filter must live inside a device_reference widget.
The device options depend on site_type, which is derived from the selected site option's location_type rather than from a sibling field value.
Query-param precedence (remote_mac_address overrides site/device-id/interface) cannot be expressed.
